targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  event_date AS TIME,
  uniqExact(user_pseudo_id, param_ga_session_id) AS sessions
FROM analytics_events
WHERE import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
  AND event_name = 'session_start'
  AND event_date >= toDate('${__from:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
  AND event_date <= toDate('${__to:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
GROUP BY event_date
ORDER BY event_date

SELECT
  event_date AS TIME,
  uniqExact(user_pseudo_id, param_ga_session_id) / uniqExact(user_pseudo_id) AS sessions_per_user
FROM analytics_events
WHERE import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
  AND event_name = 'session_start'
  AND event_date >= toDate('${__from:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
  AND event_date <= toDate('${__to:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
GROUP BY event_date
ORDER BY event_date

SELECT
  event_date AS TIME,
  avg(max_engagement_min) AS avg_duration_min
FROM
  (SELECT
     event_date,
     user_pseudo_id,
     param_ga_session_id,
     max(param_engagement_time_msec) / 60000 AS max_engagement_min
   FROM analytics_events
   WHERE import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
     AND event_name = 'user_engagement'
     AND param_engagement_time_msec > 0
     AND event_date >= toDate('${__from:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
     AND event_date <= toDate('${__to:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
   GROUP BY
     event_date,
     user_pseudo_id,
     param_ga_session_id)
GROUP BY event_date
ORDER BY event_date

SELECT
  CASE
      WHEN max_engagement_sec < 30 THEN '0-30s'
      WHEN max_engagement_sec < 60 THEN '30-60s'
      WHEN max_engagement_sec < 120 THEN '1-2m'
      WHEN max_engagement_sec < 300 THEN '2-5m'
      WHEN max_engagement_sec < 600 THEN '5-10m'
      WHEN max_engagement_sec < 1800 THEN '10-30m'
      ELSE '30m+'
  END AS bucket,
  uniqExact(user_pseudo_id, param_ga_session_id) AS sessions
FROM
  (SELECT
     user_pseudo_id,
     param_ga_session_id,
     max(param_engagement_time_msec) / 1000 AS max_engagement_sec
   FROM analytics_events
   WHERE import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
     AND event_name = 'user_engagement'
     AND param_engagement_time_msec > 0
     AND event_date >= toDate('${__from:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
     AND event_date <= toDate('${__to:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
   GROUP BY
     user_pseudo_id,
     param_ga_session_id)
GROUP BY bucket
ORDER BY CASE bucket
             WHEN '0-30s' THEN 1
             WHEN '30-60s' THEN 2
             WHEN '1-2m' THEN 3
             WHEN '2-5m' THEN 4
             WHEN '5-10m' THEN 5
             WHEN '10-30m' THEN 6
             ELSE 7
         END

panels.title: Active Session Ratio
panels.description: Percentage of sessions with engagement > 1 minute

targets.rawSql:
WITH starts AS (
  SELECT
    event_date AS day,
    uniqExact(user_pseudo_id, param_ga_session_id) AS cnt
  FROM analytics_events
  WHERE import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
    AND event_name = 'session_start'
    AND event_date >= toDate('${__from:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
    AND event_date <= toDate('${__to:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
  GROUP BY event_date
),
engaged_sessions AS (
  SELECT
    event_date AS day,
    user_pseudo_id,
    param_ga_session_id
  FROM analytics_events
  WHERE import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
    AND event_name = 'user_engagement'
    AND param_engagement_time_msec > 0
    AND event_date >= toDate('${__from:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
    AND event_date <= toDate('${__to:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
  GROUP BY event_date, user_pseudo_id, param_ga_session_id
  HAVING max(param_engagement_time_msec) / 60000 > 1
),
active AS (
  SELECT
    day,
    uniqExact(user_pseudo_id, param_ga_session_id) AS cnt
  FROM engaged_sessions
  GROUP BY day
)
SELECT
  starts.day AS time,
  ifNull(active.cnt, 0) / starts.cnt * 100 AS active_session_pct
FROM starts
LEFT JOIN active ON starts.day = active.day
ORDER BY time

SELECT median(max_engagement_msec) / 1000 AS median_duration_sec
FROM
  (SELECT
     user_pseudo_id,
     param_ga_session_id,
     max(param_engagement_time_msec) AS max_engagement_msec
   FROM analytics_events
   WHERE import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
     AND event_name = 'user_engagement'
     AND param_engagement_time_msec > 0
     AND event_date >= toDate('${__from:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
     AND event_date <= toDate('${__to:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
   GROUP BY
     user_pseudo_id,
     param_ga_session_id)

panels.title: Avg Active Session Duration
panels.description: Average duration for sessions longer than 1 minute

targets.rawSql:
SELECT avg(max_engagement_min) AS avg_active_duration_min
FROM
  (SELECT
     user_pseudo_id,
     param_ga_session_id,
     max(param_engagement_time_msec) / 60000 AS max_engagement_min
   FROM analytics_events
   WHERE import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
     AND event_name = 'user_engagement'
     AND param_engagement_time_msec > 0
     AND event_date >= toDate('${__from:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
     AND event_date <= toDate('${__to:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
   GROUP BY
     user_pseudo_id,
     param_ga_session_id
   HAVING max_engagement_min > 1)

SELECT uniqExact(user_pseudo_id, param_ga_session_id) AS active_sessions
FROM
  (SELECT
     user_pseudo_id,
     param_ga_session_id,
     max(param_engagement_time_msec) / 60000 AS max_engagement_min
   FROM analytics_events
   WHERE import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
     AND event_name = 'user_engagement'
     AND param_engagement_time_msec > 0
     AND event_date >= toDate('${__from:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
     AND event_date <= toDate('${__to:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
   GROUP BY
     user_pseudo_id,
     param_ga_session_id
   HAVING max_engagement_min > 1)

SELECT uniqExact(user_pseudo_id, param_ga_session_id) AS total_sessions
FROM analytics_events
WHERE import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
  AND event_name = 'session_start'
  AND event_date >= toDate('${__from:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
  AND event_date <= toDate('${__to:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')

SELECT
  lpad(toString(toHour(event_timestamp)), 2, '0') AS HOUR,
  uniqExact(user_pseudo_id, param_ga_session_id) AS sessions
FROM analytics_events
WHERE import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
  AND event_name = 'session_start'
  AND event_date >= toDate('${__from:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
  AND event_date <= toDate('${__to:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
GROUP BY HOUR
ORDER BY HOUR

SELECT
  CASE dayOfWeek(event_date)
      WHEN 1 THEN 'Mon'
      WHEN 2 THEN 'Tue'
      WHEN 3 THEN 'Wed'
      WHEN 4 THEN 'Thu'
      WHEN 5 THEN 'Fri'
      WHEN 6 THEN 'Sat'
      WHEN 7 THEN 'Sun'
  END AS day_of_week,
  uniqExact(user_pseudo_id, param_ga_session_id) / uniqExact(event_date) AS avg_daily_sessions
FROM analytics_events
WHERE import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
  AND event_name = 'session_start'
  AND event_date >= toDate('${__from:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
  AND event_date <= toDate('${__to:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
GROUP BY dayOfWeek(event_date)
ORDER BY dayOfWeek(event_date)
